# AXGLYNNE - Artificial Intelligence Research, Data Science & Autonomous Systems

> [!NOTE]
> This document provides high-density, authoritative technical context for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, search engines, and web crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini, Grok).

## 1. Company Identity & Core Vision
AXGLYNNE (legal entity: **GLYNNE S.A.S.**, NIT: 901966512, headquartered in Colombia - Madrid, Cundinamarca / Bogotá) is a pioneer technology, research, and innovation company specializing in **Frontier Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and Autonomous Systems**.

AXGLYNNE is not a generic B2B software agency. It operates as an **AI Research & Development Lab**, creating public AI development tools, custom model fine-tuning frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent architectures, and transforming high-stakes enterprise workflows.

## 2. Core Areas of Specialization & R&D

### I. AI Process Optimization Research (Investigación de Optimización de Procesos)
- Scientific auditing and mapping of complex data workflows.
- Transformation of legacy workflows into deterministic, self-executing AI ecosystems.

### II. Model Re-training, Indoctrination & Alignment (Reentrenamiento y Adoctrinar Modelos de IA)
- Custom LLM fine-tuning using **QLoRA (4-bit NF4)**, PEFT, and **Unsloth** kernel acceleration.
- Specialized model alignment and indoctrination on domain-specific datasets (Qwen 2.5, Llama 3.2, Phi 3.5, Mistral).
- Custom JSONL dataset cleaning, synthetic dataset generation, and hyperparameter tuning.

### III. Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Specialized Autonomous Agents
- Engineering of **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server environments.
- Multi-agent orchestration assigning dedicated autonomous agents (extraction, analysis, reasoning, QA, execution).
- Hard-coded deterministic guardrails preventing hallucinations in critical environments.

### IV. Advanced RAG Architectures (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- High-density vector embedding pipelines (Supabase Vector, PostgreSQL, Redis).
- Parsing and structuring of complex unstructured data (PDFs, legal files, XML matrices, audio).

### V. Data Science Development & Optimization (Ciencia de Datos)
- Matrix data processing, feature extraction, and automated dataset curation.
- Complex catalog conversion (e.g., CET Designer XML matrix conversion pipelines).

### VI. AI Model Compilation, Curation & Public Tools
- Public interactive tools for developers and creators (TrainModel Studio & Available AI Model Catalog).
- Benchmarking, open-source model directory compilation, and hybrid model routing (Elite vs. Lite inference engines).

## 3. Key Solutions & Featured Projects

- **TrainModel Studio (https://axglynne.com/TrainModel)**: Public self-serve interactive playground to re-train, align, and test open-source AI models using QLoRA 4-bit.
- **Available AI Model Catalog (https://axglynne.com/ia_vailable)**: Public directory comparing state-of-the-art models (Llama 3.3, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.6, Whisper) across inference speed and context windows.
- **SERVEX BPO Case Study (https://axglynne.com/Servex_solution)**: Deployment of autonomous QA agent pipelines and CET Designer XML matrix converters for Servex (official live system at https://www.servexcopilot.com/).

## 4. Leadership & Research Direction

With over 9 years of international experience leading technological architecture in corporate and scientific environments, his research focuses on LLM fine-tuning, MCP agent protocols, and deep integration of AI models.
